name: Ghost Rider
description: Load a previous .fit or .gpx of the current road and race against a 3D ghost rider + live time/power gap.

settings.label: Show 3D ghost cyclist in world
settings.description: Renders a 3D ghost cyclist into Biketerra's scene along the road.

settings.label: 3D ghost avatar style
settings.description: exact = exact copy of your avatar & jersey (with transparency/tint below) · tinted = solid spectral cyan · simple = lightweight mesh

settings.label: Ghost opacity (%)
settings.description: 15 – 100 · transparency of the cloned ghost avatar (100 = solid)

settings.label: Ghost cyan tint (%)
settings.description: 0 – 100 · subtle icy ghost tint over your cloned avatar

settings.label: Show floating ghost nameplate
settings.description: Projects a live gap & watts label above the ghost in 3D space.

settings.label: Lane side offset (m)
settings.description: Sideways offset from the road centerline (+ right, - left) so the ghost sits beside your bike.

settings.label: Auto-start when you begin riding
settings.description: Starts the ghost clock automatically once your speed exceeds 2 km/h.

settings.label: Pause ghost when you stop
settings.description: Off = strict time-trial clock that keeps running if you stop pedaling.

settings.label: 3D ghost solidity (passes)
settings.description: 1 = translucent ghost · 2–3 = more solid (uses extra draw passes).

settings.label: Fallback speed for timeless GPX (km/h)
settings.description: Used when loading a GPX route file that has no <time> timestamps.
